answer_2.quote: The reported scores follow the main evaluation metrics defined in the original benchmark papers: Acc@1 for synthetic tasks in LONGEMBED, nDCG@10 for real tasks in LONGEMBED and all tasks in BRIGHT, nDCG@5 for News21 in FOLLOWIR, MAP@1000 for Robust04 and Core17 in FOLLOWIR, and p-MRR for all subsets in FOLLOWIR.

answer_3.quote: For such scenario with a large number of relevant documents in the corpus, we recommend to use the LLM-as-judge approach for evaluation like Siyue et al. (2024); Song et al. (2025).
